answer: Post a bond or get nothing. 250 POA per identity, payout capped at 40 POA per epoch, so the bond covers 6 good epochs and a slash takes all of it. No bond, no wharf access, no grading seat. A dune of 1,000 identities is 250,000 POA parked for 6 epochs before the first useful coin, and every vertex of that farm gets funded separately. Boring, works, and the attacker pays first.
